outcome_access: No empirical outcome data opened for this assessment

vocabulary.known: Anderson plus eligible Warriner adjectives; eligibility independent of norm coverage
vocabulary.required: Frozen eligible vocabulary, eligibility version and SHA-256; realized denominator size
vocabulary.source: analysis_plan.md: H2 details, The word list

participant_structure.known: Existing source-study response structure only: UWA and Nicolas assessed separately, preserving dependencies in their published records; no new human participants or judges
participant_structure.required: Sourced respondent–group incidence and response budgets from the existing datasets, with provenance and an outcome-access record if necessary; this is metadata verification, not recruitment
participant_structure.source: analysis_plan.md: H2 details; scripts/d1c/README.md: Design and reporting order

measurement_coverage.known: Coverage must not determine word eligibility; instruments can overlap incompletely
measurement_coverage.required: Instrument coverage mask over the frozen vocabulary, overlap, missingness assumptions and source hashes

measurement_assumptions.known: Model judgments require explicit instrument, bias, shared-error and transport assumptions
measurement_assumptions.required: Versioned instruments and prespecified sensitivity values, labelled as assumptions where not measured

estimands.known: H2 marginal predictive association and exploratory H1 fixed-usage marking comparison; prevalence and perceived display separate
estimands.required: Bind averaging populations to the frozen vocabulary and existing source-study response structure
estimands.source: analysis_plan.md: H2 details and H1 details; scripts/d1c/README.md: Estimands and truth

effect_ranges.known: D1c currently varies predictive H2 at 0 and -0.10 as design values; this is not an H1 power curve
effect_ranges.required: Separate justified H2 and H1 generating-effect ranges including zero; deterministic truth checks on the estimand scales
effect_ranges.source: scripts/d1c/README.md: Estimands and truth; DECISIONS.md: 2026-10-10 reporting priority

replication_and_compute.known: Current eight cut components are one generated dataset; full-grid engineering sweep is paused
replication_and_compute.required: Frozen cell list, independent dataset count, precision rationale, seeds, numerical cut accuracy and cost ceiling before a calibration launch

l1_l2.known: D2b evaluates model-judged estimands after the lexical frame is frozen
l1_l2.required: Realized L1/L2 frame dimensions, fixed model families, wording variants and repeated judgments, and the existing D2b stress assumptions; no new human judges

historical_design.purpose: Engineering examples only; never used as defaults for unresolved empirical inputs
